notes: Fixes Landing Category matching being unreliable across languages: match_text is now checked ONLY against a service's English and site-default-language category/name (via its Service Translation, falling back to the raw pricing-sync text only if untranslated yet) - never against whatever single language the pricing API's account happens to return, which previously made matching fail whenever that language wasn't what the admin typed. The actual name/description returned to the frontend still follows ?lang= exactly as before - only matching is now pinned to a predictable language. Catalog services matched by an active Landing Category also get automatically translated into every active language - each sync seeds a default-language service_translations row for them (if one isn't already there from the HTML scraper), picked up by the existing hourly services:refresh-catalog run's AI translation queue, same pipeline every other service already uses. The Catalog pricing sync API server (SEO > Settings) is picked from your existing Free Service Gateway > API Servers list instead of typing a separate smm.plus API key/host. Adds a public GET /api/services endpoint (restricted to the smm.plus CORS origin) serving that cached retail catalog (price/min/max, synced daily) filtered by an admin-configured landing-page category slug, with optional geo/lang filtering - for SEO landing pages that currently hardcode pricing. New SEO > Catalog Services and SEO > Landing Categories admin pages. Also corrects the earlier 1.27.30 update, which broke the Analytics page - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
